description.text: The Generations Start Decks, released on 22 November 2024: nine 60-card decks, one for each region the Pokémon games had been set in, each with two holo Pokémon ex and a sheet of damage counters and markers: Pikachu ex & Snorlax ex, Lugia ex & Tyranitar ex, Kyogre ex & Blaziken ex, Dialga ex & Lucario ex, Reshiram ex & Amoonguss ex, Xerneas ex & Noivern ex, Tapu Koko ex & Mimikyu ex, Zacian ex & Alcremie ex, and Koraidon ex & Paldean Clodsire ex. Each deck has two copies of Professor's Research drawn as its region's professor, from Professor Oak to Professor Sada, and its own version of the new Supporter Black Belt's Training set in its region. The Special Battle Set sold the same day held four of the decks with four holo promo cards.
